extracted.intended_audience: web developers / site authors integrating MathJax who need to configure accessibility features
extracted.subtask_description: Configuration and option guidance for MathJax 3.2 accessibility-related extensions (semantic enrichment, complexity, explorer, assistive-mml) to control speech, braille, collapsing, highlighting, magnification, and related behaviors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contextual menu settings (menuOptions.settings)
rubrics_metrics.description: menuOptions.settings.assistiveMml, collapsible, and explorer — booleans in the MathJax options that reflect whether assistive MathML, collapsible math, and the expression explorer are enabled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These menu settings control whether the accessibility extensions are enabled at runtime; prefer using the menu options so that if a user turns an extension off it will not incur network or startup costs. Note: there is no separate menu control for semantic enrichment itself; it is enabled automatically by enabling collapsible math or the expression explorer.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableEnrichment
rubrics_metrics.description: Boolean option (true/false) controlling whether semantic enrichment is applied to the internal MathML representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is usually controlled automatically by the context menu settings; you can set it to false to disable enrichment when the semantic-enrich component was loaded automatically but you do not need it.

rubrics_metrics.name: sre (Speech-Rule Engine) configuration
rubrics_metrics.description: Configuration block for the Speech-Rule Engine used by semantic enrichment; includes speech level (none/shallow/deep), domain (e.g., 'mathspeak'), style ('default', etc.), and locale (language code like 'en', 'fr').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See SRE documentation for details. Note: as of version 3.1.3, the former enrichSpeech option was renamed to speech and speechRules was split into domain and style.

rubrics_metrics.name: enrichError handler
rubrics_metrics.description: Function called when semantic enrichment fails: enrichError(doc, math, err) by default calls MathDocument.enrichError(), which logs a warning and falls back to original MathML.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Override this to record errors, replace output MathML with alternative error-marked MathML, or perform other custom error handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableComplexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Boolean option that controls whether the complexity extension runs and computes complexity metrics for expressions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controlled automatically by context menu settings; set false to disable complexity computations if you don't need them even when the component was loaded.

rubrics_metrics.name: makeCollapsible
rubrics_metrics.description: Boolean option that determines whether the complexity extension inserts <maction> elements to allow collapsing complex expressions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When true, complex expressions are marked and maction elements are inserted to allow users to collapse; when false, elements are only internally marked as collapsible and expressions are not altered.

rubrics_metrics.name: identifyCollapsible (developer option)
rubrics_metrics.description: Developer boolean option that decides whether complexity numbers should take collapsing into account (i.e., parents' complexity reflects collapsed children) or assume no collapsing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for customizing how complexity metrics are computed when building custom collapsing behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collapse class (developer option)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Collapse object/class to use for creating the <maction> elements for collapsing complex expressions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows providing a subclass of Collapse to customize how collapsible actions are created and behave.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComplexityVisitor class (developer option)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ComplexityVisitor object/class to manage computations of complexity values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows providing a subclass of ComplexityVisitor to change how complexity is measured and aggregated.

rubrics_metrics.name: enableExplorer
rubrics_metrics.description: Boolean option to enable or disable the explorer extension that provides interactive exploration of expressions (adds an 'explorable' action).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controlled automatically by the context menu settings; you can disable it if the explorer component was loaded automatically and you don't need it. The explorer's options are grouped under the a11y block.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speech options (a11y.speech)
rubrics_metrics.description: a11y.speech boolean toggles whether speech output is produced for expressions when the explorer is used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By default, speech is computed for every expression and output once the explorer is started. Can be turned off to avoid speech output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Braille options (a11y.braille and a11y.viewBraille)
rubrics_metrics.description: a11y.braille boolean toggles whether Braille output is produced; a11y.viewBraille toggles whether Braille output is displayed under the expression as subtitles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Braille generation is separate from displaying Braille as subtitles; use viewBraille to present Braille visually when helpful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtitles option (a11y.subtitles)
rubrics_metrics.description: a11y.subtitles boolean indicates whether the speech string for the selected sub-expression is shown as a subtitle under the expression during exploration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for sighted users alongside speech output; can be toggled independently of speech generation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlighting options (foreground/background colors & opacity, highlight type)
rubrics_metrics.description: Options to control visual highlighting during expression exploration: foregroundColor (choices: 'Blue','Red','Green','Yellow','Cyan','Magenta','White','Black'), foregroundOpacity (0..1), backgroundColor (same choices), backgroundOpacity (0..1), highlight ('None','Flame','Hover'), flame (boolean), hover (boolean), treeColoring (boolean).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose colors from the allowed set; flame permanently highlights collapsible sub-expressions with nested darkening; hover highlights on mouse hover. Note: enabling both hover and flame can cause unexpected side-effects; treeColoring applies alternating foreground colors to visually distinguish neighboring symbols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magnification options (magnification, magnify, keyMagnifier, mouseMagnifier, align)
rubrics_metrics.description: Controls for zooming sub-expressions: magnification ('None','Keyboard','Mouse'), magnify (percentage string, e.g., '400%'), keyMagnifier (boolean), mouseMagnifier (boolean), and align ('top', etc.) to place the zoomed expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using both keyMagnifier and mouseMagnifier together can cause unwanted side-effects. magnify sets the zoom factor; align controls placement of the zoomed view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semantic Info explorers (infoType, infoRole, infoPrefix)
rubrics_metrics.description: Options to enable small semantic information explorers that show semantic type (infoType), semantic role (infoRole), and prefix/position information (infoPrefix) for sub-expressions on mouse hover.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Types are document- and subject-area-dependent; roles depend on context; prefixes give positional labels like 'exponent' or 'radicand' and would also be announced during interactive speech exploration. Multiple information explorers work well together.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warning about multiple mouse-based exploration tools
rubrics_metrics.description: A guidance note that switching on multiple mouse-based exploration tools can lead to unexpected interactions and often unpredictable side effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer combining keyboard-based tools when possible; test combinations of mouse-based features before deploying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assisitve-MML extension and enableAssistiveMml
rubrics_metrics.description: The assistive-mml extension inserts visually hidden MathML into MathJax output that some screen readers can voice. It is included in combined components and active by default. The configuration option enableAssistiveMml (true/false) controls insertion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is also a menu item to let visual users turn off assistive MathML. To disable insertion via config, set options.enableAssistiveMml:false.
